label: The Tournament at Cloudgate
summary: Every sect of the Nine Rivers sends its best to the Cloudgate tournament. You were sent as a joke, and you mean to win.
title: The Tournament at Cloudgate
description: The great tournament on Cloudgate Mountain decides which sect leads the Nine Rivers for ten years. Your small sect sent you because no one else would go. The favorites are deadly, the judges are bribed, and someone is poisoning the tea.

chapterOutlines.title: The Thousand Steps
chapterOutlines.outline: Climb to Cloudgate, meet your rivals, and draw your first opponent.

chapterOutlines.title: The Poisoned Cup
chapterOutlines.outline: A favorite falls ill, and every sect suspects another.

chapterOutlines.title: The Final Bout
chapterOutlines.outline: Fight for your sect, and expose whoever wants the tournament to fail.

scene.location: The courtyard at the top of Cloudgate Mountain
scene.summary: Morning mist, banners of twelve sects snapping in the wind. A judge reads your sect’s name, and somebody laughs.

npcs.name: Lan Yue
npcs.role: Champion of the Jade Lotus sect
npcs.description: The favorite to win, polite to everyone and impossible to read.

npcs.name: Old Bao
npcs.description: Has sold tea at every tournament for forty years and hears everything.
goals: See one honest tournament before he dies
abilities: Knows every poison by its smell
